description: This Java class implements a graphical user interface for a mortgage calculator application, allowing users to input loan details, view mortgage summaries, and see an amortization schedule.

classes.name: MortgageCalculatorGUI
classes.description: Main GUI class for the mortgage calculator, handling user input, displaying results, and rendering the amortization schedule.

methods.name: MortgageCalculatorGUI
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GUI window, sets properties, and builds the interface components.

methods.name: createAndShowGUI
methods.description: Sets up the main panel and adds input, results, and amortization panels.

methods.name: createInputPanel
methods.description: Creates the input section for loan amount, interest rate, and loan term, along with the calculate button.

methods.name: createResultsPanel
methods.description: Creates the section displaying mortgage summary details like monthly payment, total payment, and total interest.

methods.name: createAmortizationPanel
methods.description: Creates the amortization schedule table panel.

methods.name: calculateMortgage
methods.description: Handles the calculation process when the user clicks the 'Calculate' button, validating inputs, creating a Mortgage object, and updating the UI.

methods.name: updateAmortizationTable
methods.description: Populates the amortization schedule table with data generated from the Mortgage object.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that launches the GUI application on the Event Dispatch Thread.
